segments.text: Okay, starting the walk from the bus stop.
Footpath is broken here, big crack and one slab is missing.
Someone could easily trip on this at night.
Drain is blocked, lots of plastic in it.
Huge rain tree here, nice shade.
Cars parked fully on the footpath, I have to walk on the road.
Streetlight not working, this is pole number forty two.
Garbage dumped near the corner, smells bad.
Water logging here even though it rained two days ago.
Footpath here is nice and wide, really good.
No zebra crossing at this junction and vehicles come very fast.
Okay, that's the end of the walk.
Oh, open drain right next to the school gate, no cover.
